payload.aiSummary: Allandale, located between Burnet Road and MoPac Expressway, is a residential and retail Austin neighborhood with mid-century ranch homes and a leafy, low-slung streetscape. The neighborhood’s character concentrates around the Burnet Road corridor near Anderson Lane, where taco counters, indie boutiques, and patio restaurants keep the sidewalks active. Local pillars include the original Alamo Drafthouse Cinema on Anderson Lane, the long-running Yard Bar, and the beloved Upper Crust Bakery. Curving streets and mature trees frame a calm, walkable feel, while pocket parks and school grounds add open space. The mix of classic brick facades and updated remodels gives the area a quietly modern Austin look.
